en: Black-and-white postcard view of a wide river with calm water, tree-lined banks, and a curving road in the foreground. In the distance are bridges crossing the river and small buildings along the shoreline. Industrial chimneys and low hills are visible on the horizon. Printed text at the bottom right identifies the scene as Trollhättan and the northern river channel.
